2336: function _M:onHeal(value, src)
2337: 	local raw_value = value
2338: 	value = value * util.bound((self.healing_factor or 1), 0, 2.5)
2339: 
2340: 	for cb in self:iterCallbacks("callbackOnHeal") do
2341: 		local ret = cb(value, src, raw_value)
2342: 		if ret then
2343: 			raw_value = ret.raw_value or raw_value*ret.value/value
2344: 			value = ret.value
2345: 		end
2346: 	end

56: function _M:heal(value, src)
